plan: Full experiment design delivered (stage=result). Headline metric operationalized as the per-(dataset, seed) argmin of the mean validation MSE across horizons {96, 192, 336, 720}, with win rate vs CycleNet-paper default and relative regret vs grid oracle as complementary headline quantities. Primary estimators are ACF (argmax of |rho(ell)| over the frozen candidate set with shortest-L tie-break) and FFT (argmax of |X(1/L)| over the frozen set on linearly-detrended training series); top-3 retained for sensitivity. PACF is restricted to diagnostic / ablation use, never as an L-supplier. CycleNet arbitrary-integer-L for its Residual Periodic Encoding is declared as an architectural assumption verified against the paper description; a synthetic-series sanity check (pure/noisy/trended sinusoids at L_true in {24, 168, 720}) is included in the viability section to validate this and the metric. Datasets: ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1, ETTm2, Weather, Electricity, Traffic, Exchange. Candidate sets are frozen and explicit: Daily = {24, 48, 72, 96, 168, 336, 720} for Exchange; SubDaily = {24, 48, 96, 168, 336, 720, 1440} for sub-daily-granularity datasets; v1 uses a per-dataset global-aggregation series (mean across channels) computed only on the training split. Controls: paper-default, random-uniform, ACF, FFT, ACF-union-FFT-best-of, oracle (grid argmin), and broadcast-exhaustive small-grid sanity. Protocol: fixed 70/10/20 splits, lookback 96, horizons {96, 192, 336, 720}, at-least-3 seeds, CycleNet paper-number-of-epochs, Adam lr=1e-3 cosine, early-stopping on val MH. Sensitivity matrix covers ACF window truncation, detrending (none/linear/first-diff/STL-style), FFT top-k, candidate band dropout, horizon x lookback (3 x 4 cell), and per-channel aggregation as optional. Analysis plan: per-cell MSE to MH to median L* across seeds; Wilcoxon signed-rank with Holm-Bonferroni per (dataset, horizon, length-source pair) and Friedman with Nemenyi across lengths aggregated over horizons; bootstrap CIs (B=1000) for WR and Reg; tables T1 headline, T2 win-rate/regret, T3 sensitivity; figures F1 heatmap, F2 oracle curves, F3 ACF+FFT overlays, F4 sensitivity tornado. Data-leakage policy: estimators computed only on train; oracle selects L on val and reports on test with overfit gap; random seed stream decoupled from training seeds; ethics limited to benchmark-data use. Viability: estimator compute negligible; sanity check under 1 h CPU; headline sweep approximately 672 cells equals 30-60 CPU-h sequential, at-most 4-6 h with 24-core parallelism; total wall-clock 8-10 h sequential, 2-4 h parallel within budget. Failure-mode triggers defined. No claim of execution.
